text.p: Typhoon Rosie is expected to bring winds of 75 mph to coastal areas of southwest Honshu Japan during the next 24 hours. The system weakens some as it crosses from south to north across western Honshu and moves into the Sea of Japan during the weekend. Very heavy rains will likely cause flooding and mudslides in this area during the period. Rough seas and strong winds will impact shipping and boating in and around the region but especially between the east coast of Shikoku and the coast of Honshu. Coastal areas will also have to deal with a storm surge during this time, including the region near Osaka.

Moderate to heavy rain may develop later today into Saturday in northeastern Europe, including Poland, the Czech Republic, and eastern Germany, where recent flooding has been severe. Additional flooding is likely to occur with the next round of rain.

Tropical storm Danny is a risk to shipping and boating off the southeast New England coast and near southern Novia Scotia during the next 24-36 hours. A tropical storm warning has been issued for southeast Massachusetts, including Cape Cod, Nantucket and Marthas Vineyard.
